charter_link: ANCP_TM_D1_v1 Table 3: WAPE of segment demand forecast vs same-period-last-year forecast (target: 15% or more lower), evaluated on a time-based holdout of public transaction history; 80% prediction-interval coverage between 75% and 85%. Risk R4: keep the final holdout untouched until D5.
problem: Weekly demand forecast per segment, horizons 1 to 4 weeks ahead (direct multi-horizon). Segment = product type x master colour within a department, the H&M stand-in for Sparta's category + colour family segment (H&M has no fit field).
weeks: 104 full 7-day weeks ending Tuesday 2020-09-22 (week 0 = 2018-09-26..10-02, week 103 = 2020-09-16..22). The first six days (2018-09-20..25) form a partial week and are dropped.
segments: Segments with mean weekly units >= 2 in weeks 0..58 (before the first validation target). Primary evaluation: Menswear segments (Sparta is menswear). Secondary: all kept segments. Global models train on all kept segments.
primary_metric: WAPE = sum |actual - forecast| / sum actual, pooled over segments, origins and horizons 1-4

split.train: for an origin at week o, models see only weeks <= o; global models are fitted on training origins o' <= o - 4 so every training target is observed by week o
split.validation: 9 origins o = 59, 63, ..., 91; targets weeks 60..95 (2019-11-20 to 2020-07-21), spanning pre-COVID and 2020 weeks (D3 I9: do not tune on 2020 alone)
split.test: 2 origins o = 95 and 99; targets weeks 96..103 (2020-07-22 to 2020-09-22). Declared now, NOT scored in D4: held untouched until D5 (charter R4)

interval_design: Split conformal on log((y+1)/(f+1)) residuals by horizon: calibrate on validation origins 59..75, check coverage on origins 79..91
leakage_guards: Every feature for origin o uses weeks <= o only
Last-year features use week (target - 52), which is always <= o for horizons <= 4
Test origins are not run by run_experiments.py; d5 code must add them

tuning_budget.M1 scaled seasonal naive: grid: recent window {4, 8, 13} x shrink {0, 0.5, 1} x last-year smoothing {1, 3} = 18
tuning_budget.M3 LightGBM Tweedie, global: random search 12 trials, sampler seed 42, model seed 42; best re-run with seeds 1, 2, 3

selection_rule: Lowest pooled validation WAPE on Menswear segments; ties to the simpler setting
